Nation observes one-minute 'blackout' marking 'Genocide Day'
2019-03-25T18:42:44+06:00 | UNB, Dhaka
https://www.thedailystar.net/country/news/nation-observes-one-minute-blackout-tonight-march-25-bangladesh-genocide-day-1720192

For the third successive year, the nation observed a one-minute 'blackout' programme on Monday night, marking the 'Genocide Day'. The 'blackout' programme was observed from 9pm. Lights were switched off for one minute. However, establishments of emergency services remained out of the purview of the programme.

ALSO READ: Freedom in the air - An Online Repository on 1971 Bangladesh Liberation War

In 2017, the government officially declared March 25 as the 'Genocide Day', marking the widespread killings by Pakistani Army on the unarmed Bangalees on the black night of March 25, 1971.
